questions.text: Should the fee be added automatically, or does finance approve each one first?

options.label: Finance approves each fee
options.detail: Fewer disputes with big customers; keeps the first version small.

options.label: Added automatically
options.detail: No manual work, but disputes go to account managers.

options.label: 30 days after the due date
options.detail: Matches the reminder emails customers already get.

answers.question: Should the fee be added automatically, or does finance approve each one first?
answers.answer: Finance approves fees above 500 EUR; smaller ones are added automatically.

answers.question: When does the fee start?
answers.answer: 30 days after the due date — Matches the reminder emails customers already get.
